Choose Your
Experience.

Bluqar is not a resort. We operate around the water: helping guests move through Royal Belum, explore the lake and stay onboard a large houseboat.

01

Boat Service

Boat transport and lake movement for guests travelling around the Royal Belum / Pulau Banding area.

  • Lake transfer / boat charter enquiries
  • Suitable for families, groups and organised trips
  • Route and timing confirmed based on request
02

Large Houseboat Stay

Stay overnight on the lake aboard a large houseboat — your accommodation, gathering space and floating base in one.

  • Overnight houseboat accommodation
  • Designed for group-style stays
  • Capacity and facilities confirmed per booking
03

Houseboat + Exploration

Combine your houseboat stay with boat outings into Royal Belum for a more complete multi-day lake experience.

  • Houseboat as your floating base
  • Boat excursions to selected destinations
  • Ideal for longer Royal Belum getaways

How The
Trip Works.

A simple flow that immediately explains the service to first-time Royal Belum visitors.

01

Arrive

Meet at the confirmed Pulau Banding / Royal Belum boarding point.

02

Board

Board the arranged boat or houseboat and receive trip instructions.

03

Explore

Travel across the lake to the selected Royal Belum destinations included in your arrangement.

04

Stay

For houseboat packages, return to your floating base and stay overnight on the lake.
